answer_1.quote: Generating long-form answers to ambiguous questions involves presenting all valid interpretations alongside their corresponding answers.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form answers, rewritten queries, clarifying questions

answer_2.quote: Metrics typically used for ambiguity detection include classification metrics such as Precision, Recall, F1, Accuracy, and AUROC score . For ACQ, the metrics are usually automatic text evaluation metrics, such as BLEU or ROUGE . ... BLEU and ROUGE are popular choices for measuring the quality of rewritten queries. Additionally, ... standard IR metrics such as mean reciprocal rank (MRR), mean average precision (MAP), and Recall@k and Precision@k are used.
